fact.subject: GlobalFoundries
fact.object: FDX Fusion FD-SOI 工艺路线

evidence.quote: The new fabrication technology from GlobalFoundries is called FDX Fusion, and it promises 7nm-class 'digital performance' (an ambiguous claim; we will try to interpret it later) and more than twice the transistor density of its original 22FDX process introduced circa 2015. To achieve its target goals, the first generation of FDX Fusion will combine innovations in SOI substrates, transistor structures, and back-end interconnects, though keep in mind that GF has not disclosed transistor dimensions, contacted gate pitch, minimum metal pitch, or actual transistor density.

GlobalFoundries said it plans to deliver initial demo silicon for customer evaluation in early 2027, followed by the first process design kit (PDK) in mid-2027. The company is already collaborating with several customers on the technology, although it has not identified specific products or committed production volumes. Specifically, GF mentioned in its press release that BMW, Bosch, Infineon, NXP, Siemens, and Tesla have expressed interest in FDX Fusion, though only Infineon specifically confirmed collaboration on future 7nm-class technologies for radar and wireless communications.

title: GlobalFoundries unveils 7nm-class FDX Fusion node — comes 7 years after firm abandoned FinFET
displayTitle: GlobalFoundries 公布 FDX Fusion 路线，样片计划 2027 年提供
entities: FDX Fusion FD-SOI 工艺路线
summary: GlobalFoundries 公布面向低功耗和边缘设备的 FDX Fusion FD-SOI 工艺路线，自称相对 22FDX 提升密度；计划 2027 年提供客户样片及 PDK，尚未公布实际晶体管密度。
investorNote: 7nm 级是厂商的性能定位，能否形成客户量产项目要看 PDK、样片良率与真实成本。
narrative: GlobalFoundries 公布 FDX Fusion FD-SOI 路线，瞄准汽车、工业和边缘 AI 等低功耗场景，计划在 2027 年交付评估样片与设计套件。报道指出其“7nm 级”说法缺少晶体管尺寸和实测密度，不能直接等同于成熟 FinFET 7nm 制程；真正的投资节点是客户设计导入与后续良率。
